APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_I.title: Affidavit-2 Digital Signature Requirement
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_I.summary: Affidavit-2 on e-stamp paper with digital signature of Chairman/Secretary of the Trust/Society/Company.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_II.title: Payment Receipt of TER Charges
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_II.summary: Copy of pay-in slip / payment receipt in respect of Technical Education Regulatory (TER) charges paid as per Table 2.1.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.title: Building Completion / Occupancy Certificate
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_III.summary: Certificate from Competent Authority (Building License / Form D / Completion / Occupancy) as specified in Clause 7.17 and Annexure-14.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_IV.title: Structural Stability for Buildings Older than 30 Years
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_IV.summary: Valid Structural Stability Certificate from registered Structural Engineer if the building is more than thirty years old.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_V.title: Valid Fire and Life Safety Certificate
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_2_CLAUSE_2_1_V.summary: Valid Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Competent Authority of the respective State/UT Government as per Clause 7.16.

APH_2024_27_CHAP_2_TABLE_2_1.title: TER Fee Schedule for Extension of Approval (EoA)
APH_2024_27_CHAP_2_TABLE_2_1.summary: Statutory TER charges schedule payable online to AICTE based on institution category and program levels.

APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_7_16.title: Fire and Life Safety Norms
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_7_16.summary: Mandates that institution buildings must possess a valid Fire and Life Safety Certificate from designated state fire authorities.

APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_7_17.title: Occupancy Certificate Norms
APH_2024_27_CLAUSE_7_17.summary: Mandates that building completion and occupancy certificates must be issued by the designated local planning or municipal authority.

APH_2024_27_ANNEX_14.title: State-Wise Designated Competent Authorities
APH_2024_27_ANNEX_14.summary: Official designated authorities across 36 States/UTs to issue certificates regarding Land Use, Site Plan, Building Plan, and Completion/Occupancy.

APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2.title: Format of Affidavit-2 by Chairman/Secretary
APH_2024_27_AFFIDAVIT_2.summary: Standard format of Affidavit-2 on non-judicial stamp paper declaring compliance with AICTE norms and DSC authentication.
